# Parking and Map

**Courthouse Address**

1000 Main Street, Cincinnati Ohio 45202

Attention:  Please be advised that anyone entering the Hamilton County Courthouse must enter the building and go through a Sheriff’s Security Checkpoint.  Between the hour of 8:30 A.M. to 9:30 A.M. patrons will encounter much longer lines and wait times.  Please make sure to take this into consideration when determining your arrival time.  Note:  Courthouse will open daily at 8:00 A.M.

**Walking Routes**

Using the Map to the right you will see walking routes from three separate parking lots (Identified by the Blue P Indicator) within close proximity to the Hamilton County Courthouse. Enter Courthouse from Main Street.

**Other Parking Options** There are numerous other parking lots available in the downtown area. For more information on parking please follow the link below:

[https://www.downtowncincinnati.com/exploring-downtown/downtown-cincinnati-parking](https://www.downtowncincinnati.com/exploring-downtown/downtown-cincinnati-parking)

**For information on Metro Bus Routes please click the link below:**

[http://www.go-metro.com/mapsandschedules](http://www.go-metro.com/mapsandschedules)

Metered parking is available near the courthouse, rates and times may vary.

**Hamilton County Probation Department**

# Parking Lots, Locations and Directions

**The Alms & Doepke Parkhaus Garage (credit card only)** is located at 1123 Sycamore Street at the corner of Reading Road. It is behind the Alms & Doepke Building (Department of Job and Family Services), across central Parkway from the Courthouse and one city block from the County Administration Building.  To pay for your parking at this garage you will pay online after you have arrived.  There is a QR Code near all the elevator shafts and again at the bottom of the stairwell in the garage.  Do not take a picture of the QR Code, but rather hover over the QR Code using the camera on your phone and a link to their website will appear.  Do not download the app.  Instead please pay directly through the Web Browser.  With the Jury Duty Promo Code you will pay a rate of $7.35 for your parking.  Please contact the Jury Commission (513-946-5879: hit "0" on your dialpad after 8:00 a.m.) to obtain the promo code.  If you can not figure out how to obtain the $7.35 juror rate please do not pay at the garage, but rather come to the Jury Commission Office in the Courthouse and we can help you here.

**From I-71 S**

Take Exit #2 Reading Rd.

Stay right on Reading Rd.

\- it runs into Sycamore St.

Turn right on Sycamore St.

A&D PARKHAUS will be immediately on the left side of the street.

Enter from Sycamore St.

**From I-75 S**

Take Exit #1E – Seventh St.

Turn left on Main St.

Turn right on 12th St.

Turn right on Sycamore St.

Enter A&D Parkhaus from the right side.

**From I-471 N**

Take Exit #6A

Take Exit #7 for Liberty St.

Turn left onto Reading Rd.

Turn right onto Sycamore St.

Enter from Sycamore St.

**Court and Walnut Garage (3CDC)** **(credit card only)** is located at 119 Central Parkway E.  It is located above the new Kroger development on Court and Walnut Streets.  You must enter the garage from Central Parkway.  You will receive a parking slip when you arrive at the garage gate.  While you are in the Courthouse you will come to one of the Jury Commission Offices to obtain a chaser ticket that you will use when you exit the garage.  The original ticket will go in first and our chaser ticket will go in second.  After that you will be asked to pay a rate of $6.00.  Do not attempt to use our chaser ticket at either of the walk up kiosks on the ground floor of the building.  Instead you will return immediately to your car and you will pay for your parking at the exit gate.

**From I-71 S**

Take Exit #2 toward Gilbert Avenue

Continue on Gilbert Avenue until it turns into 8th St.

Continue on 8th St. until you reach Vine St.

Turn right on Vine St.

Turn Right onto Central Parkway

Enter Court and Walnut Parking Garage from the right side.

**From I-75 S**

Take Exit #1E – Seventh St.

Turn left on Vine St.

Turn right on Central Parkway

Enter Court and Walnut Parking Garage from the right side.

**From I-471 N**

Take Exit #6B on 6th St.

Continue on 6th St. to Vine St.

Turn Right onto Vine Street

Turn Right onto Central Parkway

Enter Court and Walnut Parking Garage from the right side.
